name: compact-component-usage
goal: Component cards show one uncategorized Used In list of at most three consumer links, followed by an ellipsis only when more consumers exist.

evidence: Current component cards group consumers under Pages/Shells/Components and show all seven AccountMenu consumers. Requested: one list, first three links, ellipsis only for overflow.

Existing usage tests checked scope and empty consumers, but not the 3-link boundary or grouped labels. New unchanged unit cases cover 0/1/3/4/7 consumers in current and historical scopes; existing browser host tests now reject category labels.

Committed regression 406b2b324 fails with expected 4 to be 3 and category headings still present; loop record --phase red preserved immutable proof. The unchanged browser regression fails at all three widths (expected zero category labels, received one), with before screenshots captured and inspected.

Opus 5.5 extended the existing flat shared usage footer with an optional unbounded-by-default limit. Only component cards pass flat layout and limit 3; overflow is a visible ellipsis with accessible omitted-consumer count. Other card variants remain unchanged.
